dataCollection.title: Data Collection
dataCollection.intro: Two independent consent switches. We never collect research content: no paper full texts, no PDFs, no note or conversation text, no credentials, no usernames or user paths. You can change these at any time.

export.title: My data
export.description: Your research data is stored locally and belongs to you
export.label: Export my data
export.rowDescription: Export all papers, notes, evidence sets, evidence and reviews as a zip in the open object standard format

posthog.label: Product analytics (PostHog)
posthog.description: Feature usage events such as search, review generation and login — counts and durations only, never query text or document content. EU data residency.

agentEvolution.label: Agent self-evolution signals
agentEvolution.description: Five categories of structured signals (task structure, tool use, model choice, errors, workspace structure) plus implicit feedback (copy / save / cite / discard / retry). Independent channel, physically isolated from PostHog. Schemas are auditable in the repository.

regionDefault.gdpr: Your system region appears to be in the EU/EEA (or could not be determined): both switches default to off and require explicit opt-in (GDPR).
regionDefault.nonGdpr: Your system region appears to be outside the EU/EEA: both switches default to on and can be turned off at any time (opt-out).

dataCollection.sentryNote: Crash reporting (Sentry) is always on to keep the app stable. Reports are strictly redacted: no email, no IP, and local path usernames are replaced with placeholders.
